# barcode-febraban (compact)

> Draw a Brazilian boleto barcode: ITF (Interleaved 2 of 5), the Febraban código de barras symbology. Encode an even-length digit string for the BarcodeInterleaved2of5 font. Not EAN, UPC, or Code 128. Not a linha digitável converter and not a DAC (módulo 11) calculator.

Repository: https://github.com/allansli/angular-barcode-febraban
Pages: https://allansli.github.io/angular-barcode-febraban/
Index for agents: https://allansli.github.io/angular-barcode-febraban/llms.txt
Versions on npm: 2.0.0. Do not bump them from docs.

## Which package

| App | npm package | Call |
|---|---|---|
| Vanilla JS | @allansli/barcode-febraban-core | generateBarcodeSequence(digits) |
| AngularJS 1.x | @allansli/angular-barcode-febraban | <ng-barcode-febraban barcode-sequence="..."> |
| React 16.8+ | @allansli/react-barcode-febraban | <BarcodeFebraban sequence="..." /> |
| Vue 3 | @allansli/vue-barcode-febraban | <BarcodeFebraban sequence="..." /> |
| Angular 15+ | @allansli/ng-barcode-febraban | <barcode-febraban [sequence]="..."> |

`@allansli/angular-barcode-febraban` is AngularJS. `@allansli/ng-barcode-febraban` is Angular.

## Install

```
npm install @allansli/barcode-febraban-core
npm install @allansli/angular-barcode-febraban
npm install @allansli/react-barcode-febraban
npm install @allansli/vue-barcode-febraban
npm install @allansli/ng-barcode-febraban
```

Framework packages depend on `@allansli/barcode-febraban-core`. Also import `@allansli/barcode-febraban-core/assets/css/barcode.css`. The CSS `@font-face` points at `../fonts/BarcodeInterleaved2of5.ttf`. That file is not on npm. Host a copy you are allowed to use.

## Vanilla JS

```js
import { generateBarcodeSequence } from "@allansli/barcode-febraban-core";

const sequence = generateBarcodeSequence("1234567890");
// Even length, digits only. 44-digit código de barras works.
// 47-digit linha digitável, odd length, non-digits, non-strings → "".
```

Browser: load `node_modules/@allansli/barcode-febraban-core/src/generate-barcode-sequence.js`, then `barcodeFebrabanCore.generateBarcodeSequence`. Render the string in an element with class `barcodei2of5`.

## React

```jsx
import BarcodeFebraban from "@allansli/react-barcode-febraban";
import "@allansli/barcode-febraban-core/assets/css/barcode.css";

export function BoletoBarcode() {
  return <BarcodeFebraban sequence="1234567890" />;
}
```

`sequence` is a string, never a number. Peer: `react` >= 16.8.0.

## Vue 3

```vue
<template>
  <BarcodeFebraban sequence="1234567890" />
</template>

<script setup>
import { BarcodeFebraban } from "@allansli/vue-barcode-febraban";
import "@allansli/barcode-febraban-core/assets/css/barcode.css";
</script>
```

Peer: `vue` >= 3. Not Vue 2. Default export is the plugin: `app.use(BarcodeFebrabanPlugin)`.

## Angular 15+

```typescript
import { Component } from "@angular/core";
import { BarcodeFebrabanComponent } from "@allansli/ng-barcode-febraban";

@Component({
  standalone: true,
  imports: [BarcodeFebrabanComponent],
  template: `<barcode-febraban [sequence]="codigoDeBarras"></barcode-febraban>`
})
export class AppComponent {
  codigoDeBarras = "1234567890";
}
```

NgModule apps import `BarcodeFebrabanModule` from the same package. Peers: `@angular/core` and `@angular/common` >= 15.

## AngularJS 1.x

Load core before the directive. Peer: `angular` >= 1.5 < 2.

```html
<script src="node_modules/@allansli/barcode-febraban-core/src/generate-barcode-sequence.js"></script>
<script src="node_modules/@allansli/angular-barcode-febraban/dist/angular-barcode-febraban.min.js"></script>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="node_modules/@allansli/barcode-febraban-core/assets/css/barcode.css" />
<script>
  angular.module("myApp", ["angular-barcode-febraban"]);
</script>
<ng-barcode-febraban barcode-sequence="1234567890"></ng-barcode-febraban>
```

## When not to use

- EAN, UPC, Code 128, QR, or any symbology other than ITF / Interleaved 2 of 5.
- Converting a 47-digit linha digitável to 44 digits.
- Computing or checking the DAC (módulo 11), nosso número, or a boleto PDF.
- A canvas or SVG barcode that does not use BarcodeInterleaved2of5.ttf.
